product_one_liner.value: Advocate provides commercial insurance brokers and lenders with software that automates policy servicing and benchmarks policy coverage and pricing to surface coverage gaps and portfolio risk.
product_one_liner.notes: Product site describes servicing automation, live market benchmarking, coverage gap analysis and portfolio risk tools.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists Free, Starter, Professional, Premium and Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: Reviewed homepage, about and contact material; no customer names are shown. No suitable customer evidence found to cite.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn search result reports 74 employees, and Built In reports 69 total employees.

hq_location.notes: Company about information and LinkedIn identify New York City as headquarters/primary location.

founded_year.notes: Both sources list 2020 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The accessible blog index surfaced a funding/company announcement rather than two engineering or technical build posts; no qualifying technical blog was identified.

public_docs.notes: Homepage footer/navigation links to API Documentation at docs.advocate.app. The public documentation portal is linked by the company.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current postings are Platform Engineer, Product Engineer, Client Solutions Manager and Insurance Consultant; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Privacy information does not name a model provider or subprocessors; the available product blog and public-facing information located did not disclose one.

compliance_certs.notes: Reviewed privacy information does not name any of the specified certifications.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement and dated press release identify an $18 million seed round in August 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 seed funding announcement falls within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current job board lists five roles, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The company emerged from stealth and announced the launch of its standardized commercial-insurance pricing and coverage benchmarks in August 2026, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: David Haddad's LinkedIn profile reports joining as Head of Product Engineering in May 2026, a VP-level-equivalent functional leadership role within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reviewed current job postings and contact/integration-related company pages; none names a CRM or sales/marketing system.
